slots.name: German sappers deployed
slots.sentence: Since June, around 40 German sappers, or combat engineers, have been helping to establish the defenses.

slots.name: blocks laid
slots.sentence: In the six weeks since their deployment, the German engineers have laid more than a kilometer of blocks.

slots.name: border setback
slots.sentence: This installation, around 200 meters back from the border, consists of three rows of these concrete blocks.
